findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V145 renders shows the authored overskirt surface is smoother than the V144 cloth-baked surface, but its armature-only deformation still breaks the intended skirt silhouette. In crouch the front shell opens and exposes the shorts/upper thighs; in sit it forms stiff angular flaps around the knees, and in prone it lifts into a broad rigid sheet.

Neutral front/back views show a broad, nearly conical skirt with weakly readable panel pleats and an uneven hard hem transition; side views show the skirt depth and panel edges do not resolve into a controlled garment drape. The stronger hem-follow weights did not produce an acceptable continuous silhouette.
The abrupt horizontal shelf at the waist-to-hip join and angular triangular surface artifacts along the torso sides remain visible in neutral and posed views.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. V145 improves the neutral skirt surface by preserving authored panels, but the armature hem-follow strategy still fails crouch, sit, and prone coverage and silhouette. Stop parameter-only cloth/weight tuning; revise the overskirt panel geometry and pose construction to maintain coverage through bent-leg poses, and resolve the waist/hip/torso discontinuities before another 11-view review. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, VRChat, and release remain independent gates.
